purpose: Normalize fresh raw trade observations into deterministic candle inputs without embedding strategy rules.
invariants: Only observations available at candle close may be used for a closed candle.
No future observation may alter a closed candle.
Candle ordering must be monotonic by open_time.
Duplicate sequence observations must not be double-counted.
Missing intervals must be represented explicitly, not silently fabricated.
No indicators, thresholds, signals, outcomes, or strategy decisions belong in this layer.
Historical Winner/Survivor data is not an input.
